locked_conventions.source_domain: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure and zero extension; the fixed source-normalized h_lambda is never unit-normalized
locked_conventions.physical_domain: I_lambda=[-log(lambda),log(lambda)] with L=2*log(lambda), logarithmic Lebesgue measure, and zero extension
locked_conventions.fourier: fhat(t)=integral f(s)*exp(-i*t*s)ds with Plancherel measure dt/(2*pi)
locked_conventions.inversion: J is physical reflection s->-s; inversion parity is not replaced by positive-frequency selection
locked_conventions.limiting_transform: the source-normalized full transform is Khat(t)=Xi(t)/4, not Xi(t)
locked_conventions.prime_block: -2*sum_(1<n<=lambda^2) Lambda(n)/sqrt(n)*cos(t*log(n)); the endpoint is inclusive and the minus sign is immutable
locked_conventions.combined_exterior: soft and hard exterior levels are formed from the complete combined nonnegative defect before blockwise absolute values
locked_conventions.projected_cross_gram: finite projected pole/source cross Grams are assembled through the exact Fourier parity projector and are not replaced by the unprojected floor-integral formula
locked_conventions.input_text: lambda numerator and precision are canonical positive integer text; binary64 parameters and JSON floating-point values are rejected
locked_conventions.input_limits: producer and verifier admit only lambda_numerator in {5,9} and dps in {80,160}
locked_conventions.runtime: mpmath==1.4.1 with outward mpmath.iv enclosures is required
locked_conventions.claim_boundary: all finite pilots are diagnostics or exact algebraic regressions; no signed floor or asymptotic residual-gap conclusion is inferred

locked_formulas.projection_tail: E_(K,N)^2<=X_(L,N)+B_lambda^2*L^3/(12*pi^4*N^3), with X_(L,N) exactly as equation (4.5) of the Mellin note
locked_formulas.effective_tail: r_sigma<=p_X+chi_X/sigma and sum_(gamma_j<=sigma)gamma_j<=chi_X/(1-sigma), with the threshold endpoint retained in the low tail
locked_formulas.bv_layer: J<=V/pi^2*(2*z-z^2/2) for z<=1 and J<=V/pi^2*(3/2+log(z)) for z>=1, z=L*M/V
locked_formulas.anchor_obstruction: the distinguished normalized anchor has constant-direction overlap O(L^(-1/2)) while the constant direction has fixed central energy beta_delta>0
locked_formulas.odd_harmonic_short: s_A=2*mu*(mathcal_L_A^(-1)-1), so positivity after pole augmentation is equivalent to the original load mathcal_L_A<1
locked_formulas.odd_edge_localization: L_A<=2*mu/(h+tau)+2*tau*m_tau/(h*(h+tau)), with m_tau bounded by exact power or squared-Chebyshev filters
locked_formulas.finite_moment_obstruction: for every fixed k there are positive spectral measures with equal moments through k and exact loads 1 plus-or-minus epsilon*Delta_n/S_n
locked_formulas.matched_pole_mass: norm(P_N*p_-)^2>=B_(lambda,N) from equation (6.3) of the odd note, forcing an uncompensated missed-pole fraction O(log(lambda)/lambda)
locked_formulas.pole_prime_identity: P_lambda=-2*mu_lambda^2-lambda*A(X)+psi_C(X)/lambda+(B0(X)+B1(X))/2, X=lambda^2, with combined cancellation retained before absolute values
locked_formulas.riesz_obstruction: unconditionally F(X) is not o(sqrt(X)); conditional on RH the normalized pole-plus-archimedean expression has a nonconstant absolutely convergent almost-periodic zero term around c0=1+gamma_E/2-log(2*sqrt(pi))
